description:
Most people think improvisers are fearless; the truth is they’ve just learnt what to do when they don’t know what to do.

This beginner-friendly introduction to improv is designed for anyone who’s ever worried about saying the wrong thing, running out of ideas, or freezing up in front of others. Through fun games, simple exercises, and guided scene work, you’ll learn how to trust your instincts, embrace uncertainty, and stay present when things don’t go according to plan.

Through the course, we’ll explore some core principles of improvisation, collaborative storytelling, and spontaneous creativity in a supportive, low-stake environment.

No acting or stage experience required. You don’t need to be funny, quick-witted, or confident. You just need a willingness to step on stage and discover that you can handle more than you think.

Schedule:

This course runs over four consecutive days:

Saturday, October 17 - 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM

Sunday, October 18 - 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM

Is your Instagram screentime begging for overtime pay? Are your friendships tested every time there is a Marvel vs DC debate?

If you are someone who knows the next brainrot song before it goes viral, join us to test your pop culture knowledge and stand a chance to win bragging rights and prizes!

The quiz will cover sitcoms, memes, entertainment, music, anime, and overall internet & pop culture. If you have never attended a quiz before, this is a great place to start. Every question is framed in a way that will let you work out the answer, and we are liberal with hints.

About Calm Your Wits:

Calm Your Wits Quizzing is a Bengaluru-based quizzing collective that curates and hosts engaging, beginner-friendly pub quizzes across India. Founded by quizmaster Sanket Mandal, they have expanded beyond the Bengaluru quizzing circuit to host regular events in Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, and Hyderabad. Launched with the intention of avoiding the intimidating archetype of traditional academic trivia, their style leans towards long-form questions, with lots of clues and audio-visual elements thrown in to help participants arrive at the answer. Quizmaster Sanket also draws heavily from humour on social media, cleverly using tweets, Instagram reels, and memes to make questions on even the most serious of topics. It’s a way of reminding people that all that doomscrolling can actually come in handy, and that knowledge can come from anywhere if we’re open to the possibilities. Expect questions that keep you guessing, hints that reward lateral thinking, and a few intentional misdirects that may have you arguing with your teammates. Come early, and come curious.

description:
Gossip! The Trivia Show Where Nothing Stays Secret.

You’ve always been the one who knew. Who told who. Who was seen where. Who said what and to whom and why it mattered.

Gossip is a live trivia game show built entirely around the world’s oldest currency — rumour, scandal, drama, and the stories people weren’t supposed to tell. Celebrity gossip, political scandals, historical intrigue, fictional drama, pop culture’s messiest moments, and the kind of story that starts with “okay don’t tell anyone but—”

Nothing is off the record. No reputation is safe. No secret stays buried.

If it was whispered, leaked, exposed, or absolutely none of your business — it’s fair game.

The Rumour Mill (Format & Rounds)

 Did You Hear? (Warm-up | ~20 mins)

Easy enough to get everyone talking. The kind of round where someone at your table will confidently say the wrong name and never live it down.

 The Grapevine (Main Rounds | ~60–75 mins)

Trivia, audio-visual rounds, identify-the-headline, and moments where you’ll either feel like the most informed person in the room or realise you’ve been completely out of the loop. Celebrity drama, political scandals, historical gossip, fictional rivalries, pop culture feuds, leaked moments, and everything in between.

 Face Off

Two tables. One piece of gossip. One team knows. The other thinks they do.

 The Bids

Bet your points. Someone will go all in on something they half-remember. That someone might be you.

 Surprise Round (whenever)

A twist nobody saw coming. That’s all we’re saying. Don’t spread it around.

How it works

Teams of up to 4 — come with your crew or we’ll find you one

Flying solo? We’ll sort you out

No gossip addiction required — just curiosity and a loose definition of “need to know”

Prizes for the winners, a good time for everyone else

You’ve always known more than you let on.

Gossip is where you prove it.

Who is Tasty Trivia?

Saloni and Susovan are the co-curators of Tasty Trivia — Ashoka University alums who turned a shared love for curiosity into a live, fun, silly trivia game show series. They design every show, question, and experience themselves, and have taken it across 6 cities with a monthly run in Bangalore. They are eyeing to take the show to the Edinburgh Fringe Festival in 2027.

Follow us on Instagram 
@gettastytrivia
 and join our 
WhatsApp community

The Clueless Crossword: A Game where Crossword meets 20 Questions!

A unique quiz meets trivia meets crossword meets gameshow!

Are you ready to tackle the ultimate brain-teasing challenge? Gather your team and step into the world of Clueless Crossword, where solving the puzzle means asking the right questions!

Here’s the twist:

• We’ve created a crossword with 20 answers, but there are no direct clues.

• Teams take turns asking yes/no questions to narrow down the possibilities.

• Example: “Is 2 down a musician?” or “Is 5 across a musical instrument?”

• Keep going until someone cracks the grid and takes the crown!

Whether you’re a trivia master, a crossword enthusiast, or just love a fun challenge, this is your chance to shine. Come solo or bring a team, your wits, and your best questions!

About Quiz Pro Quo?

QPQ is a community to introduce people to quizzing. They come together every week to crack questions on everyday topics. They have been hosting quizzes online and in person since May 2020. You can follow QPQ on their Instagram
